name: commit
description: Git commit, push, and pull-request workflows with a fixed safety floor: stage by name, refuse staged secrets, and never put a commit on the remote default branch.

interface.shortDescription: Commit, push, and PR flows with a fixed safety floor.
interface.longDescription: Commit mirrors the command surface of the official commit-commands plugin with three skills — commit, commit-pr, and commit-clean — sharing one commit flow: stage related changes by name, refuse to commit secrets, and write a message in the repository's existing style that explains why. commit-pr additionally never switches the working tree's branch; when invoked on the default branch it records the commit as a new local ref, pushes that ref, and opens the PR with an explicit head, optionally returning the local default branch to its remote state. commit-clean deletes only local branches whose upstream is marked gone, removing their linked worktrees first.
defaultPrompt: Commit, push, and open a PR.
Clean up branches whose remote is gone.
